title: Video Downloader for Vimeo
summary: Vimvid is a smart video downloader for Vimeo
description:
Want to download Vimeo videos in no time? Looking for a lightweight and superfast Vimeo video downloader with just one click? Vimvid is the solution and It’s free.

Features:
* Video with Audio - Download any Vimeo video with audio.
* All Resolutions -  Download up to 4K, 1080p, 720p, ...etc.
* Premium Quality - Download maximum available quality.
* High Speed - Ultrafast 3x download speed.
* Amazing Video Player - Play videos offline with built-in player.
* Video Share - Share videos to your favorite social media apps.
* Material Design - Beautiful and clean UI.
* Storage Friendly - Compressed and optimized video size.
* Dark Mode - Relaxing colors for night use.
* Many Settings - A lot of powerful options to select from.

Steps to download Vimeo videos:
1- In the Vimeo app, press on the share button.
2- Select video downloader for Vimeo app icon.
3- Click Download button.
4- Your Video will be downloaded to your device.

Permissions:
- Network Access - to download videos
- Read and write Access - to save your downloads

With Vimvid, Enjoy Vimeo videos anytime and anywhere.
